${row.subs.map(s => ` `).join('')}

`).join(''); printWindow.document.write(`Print Slips${tableHtml}`); printWindow.document.close(); printWindow.print(); }; return (
{Object.keys(tablesByYearAndDay).sort().map(year => (

Year Level {year}

{Object.keys(tablesByYearAndDay[year]).sort().map(date => (
{date}
{tablesByYearAndDay[year][date].map((row, idx) => ( ))}
Section Proctor Room Timeline

))}
))}
))}
); }; export default GlobalOverview;
